messages.subject: align=T
parts:
If I try to annotate one group of the tree with tip labels like this:

p <- p + geom_tiplab(aes(subset=(group==2)),color="black",size=5,align=T)

the "align dots" unfortunately are at every tip, not only the subsetted one. :(
